How much do recent team form and rest add?

The new scoring models use the teams’ recent points scored and allowed. Each arm adds a specific input so its contribution can be measured. Season-specific weights use earlier seasons, and each replay sees only the source information available before that game week.

Across independent weekly team models, N124 opponent-adjusted long history leads outright accuracy. N121 recent opponent ridge retains the validation lead on winner probability scores and margin errors. N124 short and long form leads total MAE, RMSE and CRPS. The table below compares the five new feature recipes.

Winning by a specific margin

“Win by exactly 11” counts only an 11-point win. “Win by 11 or more” includes every larger win. Both teams receive equal weight in every game, including ties. Each research policy uses season-opening weights. A market comparison needs the same team, threshold, clock and settlement terms.

N123 integer calibration led the eight eligible season-opening models on both Brier score and log loss for each of the three event groups. The table gives uncertainty in the validation lead over the next model. An interval spanning zero allows either model to be better.

Browse every registered model, metric and coverage gap
What goes into each model?
ModelFeatures and fitting
N123 integer calibrationStarts from N122 league/home. Uses preceding-season residuals to recalibrate the probability at each integer margin and total, including ties and key scoring margins.
N113 team strengthAway-minus-home differences in recent points scored and allowed, last-eight opponent net strength, last-16 team net strength, and capped rest.
N121 recent / pooled opponent ridgeTeam offense, opposing defense, home advantage and league scoring. Recent uses a 140-day half-life and ridge penalty 6. Pooled uses 330 days and penalty 12.
N025 retained historical ensembleSeven component forecasts for winner and margin; six for total. Includes scoring, points allowed, opponent strength, count models and prior out-of-fold forecast errors.
Dated quarterback modelWeekly team and starting-quarterback effects from dated pregame depth charts. Unknown starters retain the team-level estimate.
N110 with opening-market fallbackUses the N110 model where a time-qualified forecast is available, with the dated opening line supplying an explicit fallback elsewhere.

Score the model and market on identical payouts

Choose a source clock, venue, contract and model. The model and venue in each row share the exact same game IDs, payout definition and quote sample. The season total gives the calendar denominator. Missing prices, nonmatching rules and refunded outcomes can shrink the scored sample.

On the same 54 completed 2026 winner contracts, Brier scores were 0.20736 for Kalshi, 0.20747 for international Polymarket, 0.20677 for Polymarket US and 0.23011 for N124 opponent-adjusted long history. Each accepted quote was within the five-minute matching window. The full US-only cohort had 69 games.

Brier and log loss are lower when probabilities are more accurate. A positive Brier difference means that the model had more error than the venue. The interval resamples whole weeks. A 50¢ tie settlement is a fractional result. This table measures forecast skill. Fees, liquidity and executable prices are required for trading returns.

Circa five-pick cards

Each official contest week allows five distinct selections. The ranking uses P(cover) + 0.5 × P(push). A winning side earns one point, a push earns half a point, and a loss earns zero.

Two research policies tied on every validation week, earning 45/90 in 2024 and 47/90 in 2025. The preregistered primary calibrates direction and pushes. It earned 19/49 settled points in 2026. The direction-only version earned 20/49. Both still have Baltimore −4.5 open.

All 19 policies faced the same 46 official worksheets. To compare equal settled 2026 opportunities, use the far-right column covering nine complete weeks and 45 picks. The new market-anchored challenger scored 42/90 and 44.5/90 on validation, then 25.5/45 on the same complete test weeks. All 874 cards are reconstructions. Verified contest submissions total zero.
